profile.headline: Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with more than 20 years in the industry, in both technical and managerial roles. My passion is writing amazing software that everybody can use and enjoy. My ambition is to help improving the world with new, amazing technologies, by contributing as a key player in a world-top team.

Currently at Facebook, working within the WhatsApp team to deliver an even better experience to our current 2.5B+ user base, my goal is to help our product reach another billion users from all over the world. Our incredibly diverse team, consisting of engineers, product experts, data scientists, user experience wizards (and more!) aims to deliver a product that enables easy, secure and convenient communication for everybody. If you want to know more about our product and the work we do, please take a look to our website https://www.whatsapp.com/features/

We are hiring! Please check https://www.facebook.com/careers/ if you want to be part of this incredible team, or just let me know.

projects.title: NIBC Mobile
projects.description: For NIBC I researched the possibilities to develop a mobile channel that connects to their banking environment. While the design was created I matched their infrastructure to the architecture required for mobile applications. I also advised on the technical strategy.

projects.title: Greetz for Android
projects.description: Development of the android app for Greetz, a well known greeting-cards provider in the Netherlands.
